import type { ScriptContext, ScriptResult } from "@gtm-factory/core";
/** Threads post (post_published): one thread per run on the brand's next Pro (AI) account, ported from the Threads workflow (MIGRATE-1105 S4). */
const BRIEF_HEADER = "THE CAMPAIGN'S BRIEF (written by our client for this whole campaign, verbatim; it was written without knowing this person, so where it assumes something the rest of this prompt, the thread or who they are to us contradicts, those win):";

const console = { log: (..._a: unknown[]) => {}, error: (..._a: unknown[]) => {} };
/** The sandbox ships no URL class: the one thing the steps read off a URL is its host name (throws like URL on garbage). */
const URL = function (this: { hostname: string; href: string }, u: string) {
  const m = /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:[/][/](?:[^@/?#]*@)?([^/?#:]+)(?::[0-9]+)?(?:[/?#]|$)/i.exec(String(u));
  if (!m) throw new TypeError("Invalid URL: " + String(u));
  this.hostname = m[1]!.toLowerCase();
  this.href = String(u);
} as unknown as new (u: string) => { hostname: string; href: string };
type Answer = { ok: boolean; data: Record<string, any> };
function must(ctx: any, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): any {
  const r: Answer = ctx.vendor.call(name, args);
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(name + " failed (" + String(r.data.status ?? "") + "): " + String(r.data.error ?? "").slice(0, 500));
  return r.data;
}
function tolerated(ctx: any, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): any {
  const r: Answer = ctx.vendor.call(name, args);
  if (r.ok) return r.data;
  return { ok: false, status: r.data.status ?? null, error: r.data.body && Object.keys(r.data.body).length ? JSON.stringify(r.data.body) : String(r.data.error ?? "") };
}
/** The campaign's brief on a chat-service completion: appended to the system prompt (campaign-brief.ts, verbatim). */
function withBrief(body: Record<string, any>, brief: string): Record<string, any> {
  if (!brief) return body;
  const sys = typeof body.systemPrompt === "string" ? body.systemPrompt : "";
  const msg = typeof body.message === "string" ? body.message : "";
  if (sys.includes(brief) || msg.includes(brief)) return body;
  return { ...body, systemPrompt: (sys ? sys + "\n\n" : "") + BRIEF_HEADER + "\n" + brief };
}

function planRun(__now, dryRun, campaignId, brandId, offerId, startRun) {
  const dry = dryRun === true || dryRun === "true";
  const campaign = typeof campaignId === "string" && campaignId ? campaignId : null;
  if (!dry && !campaign) throw new Error("plan-run: a live run needs its campaign (a staff run without one must say dryRun: true)");
  const brand = typeof brandId === "string" && brandId ? brandId : null;
  if (!brand) throw new Error("plan-run: no brand on this run (x-brand-id)");
  const offer = startRun?.offerId ?? (typeof offerId === "string" && offerId ? offerId : null);
  if (!offer) throw new Error("plan-run: no offer (the campaign's /start-run states it; a dry run passes inputs.offerId)");
  const now = new Date(__now);
  const hour = now.getUTCHours();
  return {
    dryRun: dry,
    campaignId: campaign,
    brandId: brand,
    offerId: offer,
    now: now.toISOString(),
    date: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    inWindow: hour >= 13 && hour < 21,
    accountsQuery: { brandId: brand },
    postsQuery: { brandId: brand, since: new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString(), limit: "1000" },
  };
}
function checkTurn(plan, accounts, posts) {
  const all = Array.isArray(accounts?.accounts) ? accounts.accounts : null;
  if (all === null) throw new Error("check-turn: meta-service served no accounts list: " + JSON.stringify(accounts).slice(0, 300));
  const list = Array.isArray(posts?.publications) ? posts.publications : null;
  if (list === null) throw new Error("check-turn: meta-service served no publications list: " + JSON.stringify(posts).slice(0, 300));
  const at = (p) => Date.parse(p.publishedAt ?? "");
  const mains = list.filter((p) => p.kind === "post" && Number.isFinite(at(p))).sort((a, b) => at(b) - at(a));
  const skipped = [];
  const candidates = [];
  for (const a of all) {
    if (a.accountType !== "pro_ai") { skipped.push("@" + a.username + " (" + (a.accountTypeLabel ?? a.accountType) + ")"); continue; }
    if (a.health !== "connected") { skipped.push("@" + a.username + " (needs reconnect)"); continue; }
    candidates.push(a);
  }
  if (skipped.length) console.log("[threads-post] not posted on: " + skipped.join(", "));
  const lastOn = (a) => { const m = mains.find((p) => p.accountId === a.id); return m ? at(m) : -Infinity; };
  candidates.sort((a, b) => lastOn(a) - lastOn(b) || Date.parse(a.createdAt) - Date.parse(b.createdAt));
  const account = candidates[0] ?? null;
  const now = Date.parse(plan.now);
  const today = mains.filter((p) => new Date(at(p)).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === plan.date);
  const history = mains.map((p) => new Date(at(p)).toISOString().slice(0, 10) + ": " + String(p.text ?? "").slice(0, 400));
  const shapes = ["insight","question to the reader","short story from our facts","myth vs fact","practical tip"];
  const usedShapes = today.length;
  const shape = shapes[usedShapes % shapes.length];
  const base = { account, history, shape, todayCount: today.length, candidates: candidates.map((a) => "@" + a.username) };
  if (!account) {
    console.error("[threads-post] the brand has no connected Threads account typed Pro (AI): nothing to post on");
    return { ...base, proceed: false, reason: "no_pro_ai_account" };
  }
  if (plan.dryRun) return { ...base, proceed: true, reason: "dry_run" };
  if (!plan.inWindow) return { ...base, proceed: false, reason: "outside_publish_window" };
  const last = mains[0] ? at(mains[0]) : null;
  if (last !== null && now - last < 60 * 60 * 1000) {
    return { ...base, proceed: false, reason: "last_thread_under_" + 60 + "_minutes_ago" };
  }
  console.log("[threads-post] owed: thread " + (today.length + 1) + " today, on @" + account.username + ", shape " + shape);
  return { ...base, proceed: true, reason: "owed" };
}
function gatherFactsWith(plan, offerAnswers, offerFields, brandFields) {
  // The brand-scoped read is refused BY DESIGN once a brand sells several
  // offers (409 SEVERAL_OFFERS: "name the offer"); the offer-scoped read above
  // is then the answer, so that one refusal means "no brand-level fields".
  // Every other failure of that read is still an error.
  if (brandFields && brandFields.ok === false) {
    if (brandFields.status === 409 && String(brandFields.error ?? "").includes("SEVERAL_OFFERS")) {
      console.log("[facts] the brand sells several offers: brand-level fields are not read, the offer's own are");
      brandFields = null;
    } else {
      throw new Error("brand user-fields read failed (" + String(brandFields.status) + "): " + String(brandFields.error ?? ""));
    }
  }
  const isEmpty = (v) => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return true;
    if (typeof v === "string") return v.trim() === "" || /^unknown$/i.test(v.trim());
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.length === 0 || v.every(isEmpty);
    if (typeof v === "object") return Object.keys(v).length === 0;
    return false;
  };
  const isPlaceholder = (v) => typeof v === "string" && /^\s*placeholder\b/i.test(v);
  const render = (v) => {
    if (typeof v === "string") return v.trim();
    if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.filter((x) => !isEmpty(x)).map((x) => (typeof x === "string" ? x : JSON.stringify(x))).join("; ");
    return JSON.stringify(v);
  };

  const exact = [];
  const neverGive = [];
  const withheld = [];
  const unconfirmed = [];
  const addExact = (f) => exact.push({ id: "E" + (exact.length + 1), ...f });

  for (const a of offerAnswers?.answers ?? []) {
    if (isEmpty(a?.question) || isEmpty(a?.answer)) continue;
    if (isPlaceholder(a.answer)) {
      withheld.push({ source: "offer-answers", label: String(a.question).trim() });
      continue;
    }
    addExact({ source: "offer-answers", label: String(a.question).trim(), value: String(a.answer).trim() });
  }

  const seen = new Set();
  for (const [scope, read] of [["offer-user-fields", offerFields], ["brand-user-fields", brandFields]]) {
    for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(read?.fields ?? {})) {
      if (isEmpty(field?.value)) continue;
      // Not confirmed = the site's prefill, which nobody told us.
      if (field?.provenance !== "confirmed") {
        unconfirmed.push(scope + ":" + key);
        continue;
      }
      const value = render(field.value);
      if (isPlaceholder(value)) {
        withheld.push({ source: scope, label: key });
        continue;
      }
      if (key === "neverGive") {
        for (const item of Array.isArray(field.value) ? field.value : [field.value]) {
          if (isEmpty(item)) continue;
          const text = render(item);
          if (!neverGive.includes(text)) neverGive.push(text);
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (seen.has(key + "::" + value)) continue;
      seen.add(key + "::" + value);
      addExact({ source: scope, label: key, value });
    }
  }

  const questions = (plan?.questions ?? []).map((q) => ({ key: q.key, question: q.question }));

  const facts = { questions, exact, neverGive, withheld };
  if (withheld.length) {
    console.error("[ai-meeting-booking] withheld operator PLACEHOLDER answer(s), not facts: " + JSON.stringify(withheld));
  }
  if (unconfirmed.length) {
    console.log("[ai-meeting-booking] not used, the client never confirmed them (site prefill): " + unconfirmed.join(", "));
  }
  console.log("[ai-meeting-booking] what our client told us, the only facts the reply may state: " + JSON.stringify(facts));
  return facts;
}

function gatherFacts(offerAnswers, offerFields, brandFields) {
  return gatherFactsWith(null, offerAnswers, offerFields, brandFields);
}
function composeAngles(brand, facts, plan) {
  const b = brand?.brand ?? brand ?? {};
  const lines = (facts?.exact ?? []).slice(0, 20).map((f) => "- " + f.label + ": " + String(f.value).slice(0, 300));
  return {
    systemPrompt: "You read the live web for a social media writer. Answer in plain text, at most 8 short lines, each a fresh development of the last 7 days in the brand's industry (what happened, who, the source URL). Never an opinion.",
    message: ["BRAND: " + (b.name ?? "?") + " (" + (b.domain ?? b.url ?? "?") + ")", "TODAY: " + plan.date, "WHAT THE BRAND SELLS:", ...(lines.length ? lines : ["(no stated facts)"]), "", "Find what is new this week in this brand's industry that its buyers care about."].join("\n"),
  };
}
function planOwnSite(brand, plan) {
  const b = brand?.brand ?? brand ?? {};
  const domain = String(b.domain ?? b.url ?? "").replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").replace(/^www\./, "").replace(/\/.*$/, "");
  if (!domain) throw new Error("plan-own-site: the brand has no domain to read");
  return { domain, brandName: String(b.name ?? domain), url: "https://" + domain, brandIds: [plan.brandId] };
}
function composePickPages(site, map, plan) {
  const onDomain = (u, domain) => {
    try { const h = new URL(String(u)).hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, ""); return h === domain || h.endsWith("." + domain); } catch { return false; }
  };
  const all = map && map.ok !== false && Array.isArray(map.urls) ? map.urls : null;
  if (!all) console.error("[threads-post] could not map " + site.domain + " (" + JSON.stringify(map?.error ?? map?.status ?? null) + "): no own pages read this run");
  const urls = [...new Set((all ?? []).filter((u) => onDomain(u, site.domain)).map((u) => String(u).replace(/#.*$/, "")))].slice(0, 300);
  return {
    candidates: urls,
    count: urls.length,
    systemPrompt: [
      "You pick pages of ONE brand's own website for a social media writer who quotes only what the brand itself publishes.",
      "From the URL list, choose at most 4 pages most likely to hold: figures the brand publishes about its own results or data, customer results or case studies, and its most recent articles or launches.",
      "Copy each URL exactly as listed. Never a URL that is not in the list.",
    ].join("\n"),
    message: ["BRAND: " + site.brandName + " (" + site.domain + ")", "TODAY: " + plan.date, "", "URLS:", ...urls].join("\n"),
  };
}
function planOwnPages(pick, offered) {
  const listed = new Set(offered?.candidates ?? []);
  const asked = pick && pick.ok !== false && Array.isArray(pick.json?.urls) ? pick.json.urls : null;
  if (asked === null && (offered?.count ?? 0) > 0) console.error("[threads-post] no own pages picked (" + JSON.stringify(pick?.error ?? pick?.status ?? null) + "): no own pages read this run");
  const urls = [...new Set((asked ?? []).map((u) => String(u)).filter((u) => listed.has(u)))].slice(0, 4);
  console.log("[threads-post] own pages to read: " + (urls.length ? urls.join(", ") : "(none)"));
  return { count: urls.length, urls, url1: urls[0] ?? null, url2: urls[1] ?? null, url3: urls[2] ?? null, url4: urls[3] ?? null };
}
function composeOwnFigures(site, plan, p1, p2, p3, p4) {
  const pages = [];
  for (const p of [p1, p2, p3, p4]) {
    const r = p && p.ok !== false ? p.result : null;
    const text = typeof r?.rawMarkdown === "string" ? r.rawMarkdown : "";
    const kept = text.split("\n").filter((l) => !/^\s*([-*+]\s*)?(!?\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)\s*)+$/.test(l)).join("\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
    if (kept) pages.push("PAGE: " + (r.url ?? "?") + "\n" + kept.slice(0, 12000));
    else if (p) console.error("[threads-post] an own page read nothing (" + JSON.stringify(p?.error ?? p?.status ?? null) + ")");
  }
  return {
    pageCount: pages.length,
    systemPrompt: [
      "You read pages of ONE brand's own website for a social media writer. Use only the page text given; never another source, never a figure the pages do not state.",
      "Answer in plain text, at most 15 short lines, each one of:",
      "- a figure a page publishes: the number, what it counts, the sample if stated, the reliability label the page gives it if any (for example Robust, Signal, Early read), the page URL;",
      "- a customer result a page publishes: the result, the customer's name only if that page names it, the page URL;",
      "- an item published recently: the title, the date, the URL.",
      "Never an opinion, never a guess. If the pages publish none of these, answer exactly: (none)",
    ].join("\n"),
    message: ["BRAND: " + site.brandName + " (" + site.domain + ")", "TODAY: " + plan.date, "", ...pages].join("\n\n"),
  };
}
function composeWrite(plan, turn, brand, facts, angles, ownFigures) {
  const b = brand?.brand ?? brand ?? {};
  const domain = String(b.domain ?? b.url ?? "").replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").replace(/^www\./, "").replace(/\/.*$/, "");
  if (!domain) throw new Error("compose-write: the brand has no domain to close the thread on");
  const brandName = String(b.name ?? domain);
  const getStarted = "Get started: " + domain;
  const exact = (facts?.exact ?? []).map((f) => "- [" + f.id + "] " + f.label + ": " + f.value);
  const never = (facts?.neverGive ?? []).map((t) => "- " + t);
  const read = (r) => (r && r.ok !== false && typeof r.content === "string" && r.content.trim() ? r.content.trim().slice(0, 3000) : null);
  const web = read(angles);
  if (!web) console.error("[threads-post] no web angles this run (" + JSON.stringify(angles?.error ?? angles?.status ?? null) + "): writing without them");
  const own = read(ownFigures);
  if (!own) console.error("[threads-post] no published figures read on " + domain + " this run (" + JSON.stringify(ownFigures?.error ?? ownFigures?.status ?? null) + "): writing without them");
  const context = [
    "BRAND: " + brandName + " (" + domain + ")",
    "PUBLISHED ON: @" + turn.account.username,
    "TODAY: " + plan.date,
    "SUGGESTED SHAPE: " + turn.shape,
    "",
    "OUR FACTS (the only source of numbers besides OUR PUBLISHED FIGURES):",
    ...(exact.length ? exact : ["(none)"]),
    ...(never.length ? ["", "NEVER STATE OR OFFER:", ...never] : []),
    "",
    "OUR PUBLISHED FIGURES (read today on " + domain + ", each with its page):",
    own ?? "(none)",
    "",
    "THIS WEEK IN THE INDUSTRY (angles only):",
    web ?? "(none)",
    "",
    "ALREADY POSTED (never repeat a subject):",
    ...(turn.history.length ? turn.history : ["(none yet)"]),
  ].join("\n");
  return { variables: { brandName, getStartedLine: getStarted }, context, getStarted, brandIds: [plan.brandId] };
}
function writerPlan(pick, skip) {
  if (skip === true) return { skipped: true, templateDynastySlug: null };
  const leg = pick && pick.legKey ? pick.legKey : "unknown leg";
  const templateDynastySlug = pick && pick.template ? pick.template.templateDynastySlug : null;
  if (typeof templateDynastySlug !== "string" || templateDynastySlug.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("[writer-plan] no Threads template to write with on " + leg + ": " + ((pick && pick.templateUnavailableReason) || "features-service served none") + ". Nothing is written.");
  }
  console.log("[writer-plan] " + leg + (pick.strategyId ? " (strategy " + pick.strategyId + ")" : "") + ": template dynasty " + templateDynastySlug);
  return { skipped: false, templateDynastySlug, legKey: pick.legKey ?? null, strategyId: pick.strategyId ?? null };
}
function finalThread(draft, compose, plan, turn) {
  // content-generation /generate-thread answers at top level: { subject, post, replies }.
  const j = draft ?? {};
  const undash = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/(\d)\s*[\u2013\u2014]\s*(?=\d)/g, "$1-").replace(/\s*[\u2013\u2014]\s*/g, ", ").trim();
  const strip = (s) => undash(s).split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim() !== compose.getStarted).join("\n").trim();
  const post = strip(j.post);
  if (!post) throw new Error("final-thread: the writer returned no main post: " + JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 300));
  const replies = (Array.isArray(j.replies) ? j.replies : []).map(strip).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 3);
  const parts = [post, ...replies];
  parts[parts.length - 1] = parts[parts.length - 1] + "\n\n" + compose.getStarted;
  const scope = (plan.campaignId ?? "dry-run") + ":" + plan.now;
  return {
    subject: String(j.subject ?? "").trim(),
    post: parts[0],
    replies: parts.slice(1),
    accountId: turn.account.id,
    username: turn.account.username,
    replyCount: parts.length - 1,
    reply1: parts[1] ?? null,
    reply2: parts[2] ?? null,
    reply3: parts[3] ?? null,
    keys: { main: "threads-post:" + scope + ":main", reply1: "threads-post:" + scope + ":reply-1", reply2: "threads-post:" + scope + ":reply-2", reply3: "threads-post:" + scope + ":reply-3" },
  };
}
function classifyMain(published, thread) {
  if (published && published.ok !== false && published.postId) {
    console.log("[threads-post] published on @" + thread.username + ": " + (published.permalink ?? published.postId));
    return { outcome: "published", postId: published.postId, permalink: published.permalink ?? null };
  }
  const body = typeof published?.error === "string" ? published.error : JSON.stringify(published?.error ?? published ?? null);
  if (published?.status === 409 && /needs_reconnect/.test(body)) {
    console.error("[threads-post] @" + thread.username + " needs reconnecting (Threads refused its login): skipped, the next run posts on another account");
    return { outcome: "account_dead", postId: null, permalink: null };
  }
  throw new Error("publish-main: Threads publish failed (" + String(published?.status) + "): " + body.slice(0, 500));
}

const FEATURE = "threads-post";
const OWN_PAGES_SCHEMA = {"type":"object","properties":{"urls":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["urls"],"additionalProperties":false};

export default function run(ctx: ScriptContext): ScriptResult {
  const R: any = ctx.request ?? {};
  const brief = typeof R.brief === "string" ? R.brief.trim() : "";
  const campaignId = typeof R.campaignId === "string" ? R.campaignId : null;
  const p = planRun(R.now, false, campaignId, (Array.isArray(R.brandIds) && R.brandIds.length ? R.brandIds.join(",") : ctx.brand), null, R);
  const accounts = must(ctx, "meta.threads.accounts", { query: p.accountsQuery });
  const posts = must(ctx, "meta.threads.publications", { query: p.postsQuery });
  const turn = checkTurn(p, accounts, posts);
  if (turn.proceed !== true) return null;

  const brand = must(ctx, "brand.profile", { params: { id: p.brandId } });
  const offerAnswers = must(ctx, "brand.offer.answers", { params: { brandId: p.brandId, offerId: p.offerId } });
  const offerFields = must(ctx, "brand.offer.fields", { params: { brandId: p.brandId, offerId: p.offerId } });
  const brandFields = tolerated(ctx, "brand.fields", { params: { brandId: p.brandId } });
  const facts = gatherFacts(offerAnswers, offerFields, brandFields);

  const a = composeAngles(brand, facts, p);
  const angles = askCompletionData(ctx, withBrief({ webSearch: true, maxTokens: 4000, message: a.message, systemPrompt: a.systemPrompt }, brief));

  const site = planOwnSite(brand, p);
  const map = tolerated(ctx, "scraping.site.map", { body: { featureSlug: FEATURE, url: site.url, brandIds: site.brandIds, campaignId } });
  const offered = composePickPages(site, map, p);
  const pick = (offered.count ?? 0) === 0
    ? { ok: false, notCalled: true }
    : askCompletionData(ctx, withBrief({ responseFormat: "json", responseSchema: OWN_PAGES_SCHEMA, maxTokens: 2000, message: offered.message, systemPrompt: offered.systemPrompt }, brief));
  const pages = planOwnPages(pick, offered);
  const scraped: any[] = [];
  for (const url of [pages.url1, pages.url2, pages.url3, pages.url4]) {
    if (scraped.length >= (pages.count ?? 0)) { scraped.push(null); continue; }
    scraped.push(tolerated(ctx, "scraping.page", { body: { enrich: false, featureSlug: FEATURE, url, brandIds: site.brandIds, campaignId } }));
  }
  const own = composeOwnFigures(site, p, scraped[0], scraped[1], scraped[2], scraped[3]);
  const ownFigures = (own.pageCount ?? 0) === 0
    ? null
    : askCompletionData(ctx, withBrief({ maxTokens: 4000, message: own.message, systemPrompt: own.systemPrompt }, brief));

  const write = composeWrite(p, turn, brand, facts, angles, ownFigures);
  const writerPick = must(ctx, "template.pick", { place: "writer" });
  const writer = writerPlan(writerPick, undefined);
  const head = must(ctx, "content.template_head", { params: { slug: writer.templateDynastySlug } });
  const draft = askedWriter(ctx, "content.thread", {
      featureSlug: FEATURE,
      variables: write.variables,
      context: write.context,
      brandIds: write.brandIds,
      campaignId,
      type: head.template.type,
      ...(R.brief !== null && R.brief !== undefined ? { brief: R.brief } : {}),
    }, { dryRun: false });
  const thread = finalThread(draft, write, p, turn);

  const main = tolerated(ctx, "meta.threads.publish", { params: { id: thread.accountId }, body: { text: thread.post, idempotencyKey: thread.keys.main } });
  const published = classifyMain(main, thread);
  if (published.outcome === "account_dead") return null;
  let parent = published.postId;
  for (const n of [1, 2, 3]) {
    if (thread.replyCount < n) break;
    const reply = must(ctx, "meta.threads.publish", {
      params: { id: thread.accountId },
      body: { text: thread["reply" + n], replyToPostId: parent, idempotencyKey: thread.keys["reply" + n] },
    });
    parent = reply.postId;
  }
  return { content: { end: { success: true, stopCampaign: false } } };
}

/** ONE-WRITER-N-MODELS-1116-OTHERS: the template's writer request, its completion asked (the Rating picks the model), the result stored by content-generation. */
function askedWriter(ctx: any, door: string, body: Record<string, unknown>, extra: Record<string, unknown>): any {
  const r: any = must(ctx, door + ".request", { body });
  const request: Record<string, unknown> = r.request;
  if (!request || typeof request !== "object") throw new Error(door + ".request answered no request");
  ctx.ask({ units: {}, request });
  const done: any = ctx.get("llm_completion");
  if (!done || !done.content) throw new Error("llm_completion: " + String((done && done.unmade) || "no completion") + ". Nothing is written: the run is retried later.");
  const llm: any = done.content.llm ?? {};
  const sent: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(request)) if (k !== "strictResponseSchema") sent[k] = request[k];
  if (llm.provider === "anthropic" && request.strictResponseSchema) sent.responseSchema = request.strictResponseSchema;
  sent.provider = llm.provider;
  sent.model = llm.model;
  const runId = ctx.request && typeof ctx.request.runId === "string" ? ctx.request.runId : "";
  if (!runId) throw new Error(door + ": the run states no runId (the run that asked the completion)");
  return must(ctx, door + ".generate", { body: { ...body, ...extra, completion: { request: sent, answer: done.content.answer, runId } } });
}

/**
 * ONE-WRITER-N-MODELS-1116: this script names no model. Each completion it needs is ASKED of the LLM completion
 * Engine (the Rating picks the model for this script); the request is the call as written, minus the model.
 */
function askCompletion(ctx: any, call: Record<string, unknown>): { ok: true; data: Record<string, any> } {
  const request: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(call)) if (k !== "provider" && k !== "model") request[k] = call[k];
  ctx.ask({ units: {}, request });
  const done: any = ctx.get("llm_completion");
  if (!done || !done.content) throw new Error("llm_completion: " + String((done && done.unmade) || "no completion") + ". Nothing is written: the run is retried later.");
  return { ok: true, data: done.content.answer };
}
function askCompletionData(ctx: any, call: Record<string, unknown>): any {
  return askCompletion(ctx, call).data;
}
/** A JSON answer, read as chat.complete read it: the parsed object, else a refusal. */
function askChatCompletion(ctx: any, call: Record<string, unknown>): { ok: boolean; data: Record<string, any> } {
  const json = askCompletion(ctx, call).data.json;
  if (!json || typeof json !== "object" || Array.isArray(json)) return { ok: false, data: { error: "chat.complete: the model answered no JSON object" } };
  return { ok: true, data: json };
}
